title: Resend inline images with src=cid: show as broken or as plain attachments
symptoms: img src=cid:logo renders as a broken image
Image arrives as a separate attachment instead of inline
inlineContentId missing from the SDK attachment type
cause: Inline embedding needs the attachment field inlineContentId matching the cid in the HTML, which only exists from resend 4.8.0. Older field names from other providers are ignored.
fix: Upgrade to resend 4.8.0 or later and set inlineContentId on the attachment to the same name used after cid:.
apply: attachments: [{ filename: 'logo.png', content: buf, inlineContentId: 'logo' }] //
affected: resend (Node SDK) below 4.8.0, Resend API before August 2025
